 Fluminense's absentees for the clash with São Paulo 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Fluminense will be without five players for their clash with São Paulo this Thursday at 9:30 p.m. (Brasília time) at Morumbis, in the 35th round of the Brazilian Championship. Coach Marcão will be unable to call on Canobbio and Savarino, who are returning from international duty after representing Uruguay and Venezuela, respectively. Neither will have enough time to travel back and rest before the match. Striker John Kennedy is also out as he continues to receive treatment. Defensive midfielder Alisson is unavailable as well, but for contractual reasons: he is on loan at Fluminense from São Paulo. Meanwhile, Matheus Reis is working his way back to full training and is not yet fit to play.
